## History

Wilson and their siblings lived across the road from Grimble's. They had a stepmother who treated them horribly, behaving just as badly toward the Wilson children as Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md) behaved toward the narrator.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P80](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0080)_

## Relationships

### [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hugh-carrow--wilson.md)

Wilson and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) are academic rivals who compete against one another for the school medal. Both are students at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) who navigate their personal friendships alongside their fierce academic competition as examinations approach.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +1 more_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--wilson.md)

Wilson is an academic rival of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), with both of them competing for the top medal at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Their ongoing competition unfolds alongside their other friendships as they prepare for upcoming examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +1 more_

### [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lionel-fairlie--wilson.md)

Wilson serves under [Lionel Fairlie](../character/lionel-fairlie.md), who acts as the master of the house where Wilson is employed. His service takes place within Lionel's residence as Lionel manages his household affairs.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P0](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P22](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P27](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0027), +2 more_
